hints.title: Marking Covered Intervals
hints.text: Mark each index covered by any matching word in a boolean array.

hints.title: Locating Substring Matches
hints.text: Scan for every word occurrence using substring search and set covered indices to true.

hints.title: Tag Insertion
hints.text: After marking boolean intervals, iterate through indices and wrap consecutive runs of true flags with open and close tags.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Boolean mask marking followed by linear reconstruction.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Independently inserting tags for overlapping occurrences without interval merging creates invalid nested or duplicate markup.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: A boolean array of size N tracks merged intervals in O(N) auxiliary space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use boolean interval marking or interval sweeps to merge overlapping and adjacent bold ranges seamlessly.
